description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to creating and managing grain contexts within the Orleans runtime, including the GrainContextActivator class, provider interfaces, and related configurators for grain interleaving and context setup.

classes.name: GrainContextActivator
classes.description: Central class responsible for creating grain contexts, managing activator providers, and configuring grain contexts based on grain type and address.

classes.name: IGrainContextActivator
classes.description: Interface for creating grain contexts for specific grain addresses.

classes.name: IGrainContextActivatorProvider
classes.description: Interface for providing grain context activators based on grain type.

classes.name: IConfigureGrainContext
classes.description: Interface for configuring a grain context.

classes.name: IConfigureGrainContextProvider
classes.description: Interface for providing configuration instances for grain contexts based on grain type and properties.

classes.name: GrainTypeSharedContextResolver
classes.description: Resolves and caches shared components for each grain type, allowing configuration of shared context.

classes.name: IConfigureGrainTypeComponents
classes.description: Interface for configuring shared components for all grains of a specific type.

classes.name: ReentrantSharedComponentsConfigurator
classes.description: Configures shared components to support reentrant grain execution based on grain properties.

classes.name: MayInterleaveConfiguratorProvider
classes.description: Provides configurators for grain contexts to support MayInterleave predicates based on grain class attributes.

classes.name: IMayInterleavePredicate
classes.description: Interface for predicates that determine if a grain can interleave message processing.

classes.name: ReentrantPredicate
classes.description: Singleton predicate that always allows interleaving, used for reentrant grains.

classes.name: MayInterleaveStaticPredicate
classes.description: Predicate implementation that uses a static delegate to determine interleaving.

classes.name: MayInterleaveInstancedPredicate
classes.description: Predicate that invokes an instance method to determine interleaving, generic over grain class type.

classes.name: MayInterleaveConfigurator
classes.description: Configures a grain context to include a specific MayInterleave predicate.

classes.name: GrainCanInterleave
classes.description: Component that holds interleave predicates and determines if a message can be interleaved based on them.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new grain context for a given grain address, using the appropriate activator and configuration.

methods.name: CreateActivator
methods.description: Internal method to create and cache a grain context activator and its configuration actions for a specific grain type.

methods.name: GetComponents
methods.description: Retrieves or creates shared components for a specific grain type.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures a grain context with interleave predicates or other shared components.

methods.name: MayInterleave
methods.description: Determines if a message can be interleaved with the current grain execution based on predicates.
